issues.title: Freeze the catalog-review job
issues.body:
## Goal
Freeze the catalog-review job within the approved ListCheck scope.

## Steps
Define one persona, repeated review job, five falsifiable assumptions, false-rejection cost and excluded features.

## Outputs
`docs/PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`.

## Acceptance and validation
One input/output workflow and measurable rework-time hypothesis; exclusions match plan section 1. Review each proposed feature against the boundary.

## Dependencies
None; implementation must first be activated.

## Pitfalls
Public descriptions do not establish demand; no OCR, editing or compliance certification.

## Review evidence
Record commands, exit codes, artifact links, actual hours and reviewer findings in `docs/reviews/LC-001.md`. Estimate includes checks, review and docs; reserve is separate.

## Goal

Recompute utility gate from records: >=20% median time reduction, no observed extra hard misses, two willing repeat users. Missing external evidence forces unvalidated-prototype status.
